card: This PR replaces hardcoded extended key strings (tpub/tprv) with dynamically generated keys using the ExtendedPrivateKey helper class across 10 functional test files. It continues test framework modernization following PR #35543. This is an internal test cleanup with no impact on node behavior or consensus.
changed_since_previous: Diff provided; confirms direct replacements of static key strings with ExtendedPrivateKey.generate() across 10 test files.
evidence: PR description: 'This PR is a follow-up of PR #35543. I've updated the tests that were still using hardcoded keys, and used the ExtendedKey classes instead.'
problem: Multiple functional tests still rely on hardcoded extended key strings instead of using the standardized ExtendedKey helper classes introduced in PR #35543, keeping test setup patterns inconsistent.

risk.why: Touches only functional test files; any mistake would cause test failures in CI without affecting release binaries.

summary: Replaces hardcoded extended key string literals (tpub/tprv) across 10 functional test files with dynamically generated keys using the ExtendedPrivateKey test framework helper. This standardizes test key creation following the introduction of extended key test classes.
